Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
If a minion with a zip gun uses the gun and the opposing minion s:ce, does
the minion with the zip gun still take the damage?

Jeff

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jeff Dai <jd...@gpu.srv.ualberta.ca> wrote:
> If a minion with a zip gun uses the gun and the opposing minion s:ce, does
> the minion with the zip gun still take the damage?

No. (card text on Zip Gun states that the damage is inflicted during
strike resolution, and the rulebook makes it clear that strike resolution
is pre-empted by S:CE.)
